summary: Short kerb where cars park, but homes sit about 17 m behind it.

drivers.seclusion: Park opposite, but several detached homes 17-25 m on the same side behind a front lawn strip.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb beside a wide road; other cars parked along it, room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Residential street with steady parked cars; moderate passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both sides, so a van blends in. Signs show a 2P and no stopping mix.

flags: Homes 17 m away on own side
Low-lying: about 5.8 m elevation, Brisbane River 218 m away
Signs include No Stopping Any Time nearby
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the south side give some afternoon shade.

best_section.where: South kerb of Macquarie Street, opposite the park
